claims.evidence: Witness confirms PlayStation logo and console shape but no model number or generation marker is visible to confirm PS5 specifically.
Report notes 'console generation/version not clearly confirmed'; no rear label or disc slot confirmation shown.
No visible label, sticker, or plug type that would indicate regional origin.
Photos show general exterior only; no close-up of scratches, discoloration, or wear to confirm condition claim.
Both photos show one white controller leaning against the console base.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal fault (common issue with secondhand consoles).
risks.proof: Short video clip showing power-on, PlayStation boot screen, and controller sync.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-functional / for-parts until power-on proof is given.

risks.risk: Model/generation uncertain (could be PS4 Pro, PS5 disc, or PS5 slim).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of rear label or serial number sticker showing model number.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the lowest-value plausible generation (older/base model).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, box).
risks.proof: Photo of all included cables and original box if available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as console-only, no accessories included.

risks.risk: Storage capacity unknown, affects resale value.
risks.proof: Screenshot of system storage settings or box label showing capacity.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at smallest standard capacity for that model line.

risks.risk: Hidden cosmetic or port damage not visible in the two photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all ports, vents, and top/bottom casing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as heavily used with possible cosmetic flaws.

risks.risk: Region lock or import restrictions (UK claim) could limit usability or software compatibility.
risks.proof: Photo of regional label or box showing PAL/UK markings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as region-unconfirmed, treated as a risk factor.

proof_requests: Video of console powering on and controller syncing.
Clear photo of rear label/serial number showing exact model.
Photo of all included cables, box, and accessories.
Close-up photos of ports, vents, and casing for wear or damage.
Screenshot of system settings showing storage capacity.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a PlayStation console with one controller, so it can be priced at worst case, but model, generation, region, and functional status remain unproven and should cap the price until verified.
